role_determination_before_activation.rule: Do not infer controller or processor status from the website brand, domain ownership, project-applicant status, consulting role, billing responsibility or hosting-account ownership alone.
roles_that_must_be_reconciled: entity that determines the purposes and essential means of the AI4WORK needs-analysis research
role_determination_before_activation.required_output: documented controller/processor/subprocessor chain plus Article 28-compatible instructions/terms where applicable

privacy_and_security_requirements_before: freeze a documented controller determination anchored to the entity that actually determines the research purposes and essential means; do not assume EUROCONSULT SRL is controller merely because eucons.ro hosts the forms
freeze a public research privacy/contact channel for the determined controller
document and approve the research legal basis and complete Article 13 notice separately from acknowledgement of voluntary participation
verify and document the legal/controller-processor chain among the project applicant/leader, eucons.ro site/operator, actual hosting-account holder and Claus Web
confirm that every processor/subprocessor role applicable to the research is governed by Article 28-compatible terms and retain the account-specific contractual evidence
obtain and review the current nominal subprocessor list from Claus Web DPA Annex 4 before activation
obtain and review the account-applicable backup/retention/deletion values from Claus Web DPA Annex 5 before activation
verify web-server/reverse-proxy access-log fields and retention for the actual account; keep request bodies/raw idempotency keys out of logs and IP/device metadata out of the analytical export
provider-bound TEST TWIN must prove research files are outside document root, isolated from commercial storage, excluded from CRM jobs and subject to finite erasure replay-marker expiry
bind and test research retention/deletion independently from commercial lead retention
verify HTTPS and exact-origin CORS on the actual endpoint
run exact-head schema/minimisation/idempotency tests and provider-bound TEST TWIN browser-to-HTTP-to-store-to-export-to-NF06 smoke before any real collection
